meaning: Restaurants a reviewer excluded by hand: the drink classifier accepted a quote from the restaurant own site, and the reviewer found the quote is about another venue, a shop or a class, not about this restaurant pouring. The harvest never makes an excluded osmId a candidate, and validateRestaurantDrinksPack refuses a pack that holds one, so build:london-venues and --check fail on it. A quote a rule can refuse belongs in the classifier, not here. Hand-written.
